description: Find more moments about a topic or pattern in a finished video (one extra scoring pass). Use after analyze_clip_url to find the user's own version of a clip that worked: pass the hook or theme as the topic. The search runs asynchronously: poll list_clips(video_id); new clips appear with status PENDING and are scored a few minutes later. Each video allows a few searches in total; needs a paid ClipAI plan.

topic.description: What to look for: a theme, a question, or the hook pattern of a clip that worked (max 200 chars).

video_id.description: A READY video of the org (from list_videos).

name: find_moments
